resolution.rationale: Goals stay AIR-only upstream in v0.99.1 and there is still no provider-neutral opt-in, so the patch is not absorbed. The v0.99.1 src/acp-agent.ts edits are: the isLoginRequiredText helper that treats any CLI 'run /login' text (including 'Login expired · Run /login') as authRequired and excludes usage-limit banners from isSyntheticLoginMessage (#1481); an AIR-only skill-file read through getContextUsage().skills.skillFrontmatter that marks plugin, bundled and nested skills as skills in available_commands (#1473); and an AIR-only approved-plan identity, plan-mode:<tool-call ID>, passed to planModeUpdate and through a new isAirClient() hook of the ExitPlanCoordinator host (#1469). The other v0.99.1 source changes are session/fork searching all projects instead of the target cwd (#1483, src/fork-session.ts) and subagent titles taken from the task (#1479, src/native-subagents.ts); neither touches a patch file. None of them reads or advertises the goal capability, calls goalMeta or the GOAL_* constants, or changes a goal call site; the goal-command failure check now uses isLoginRequiredText, which applies equally to the opted-in non-AIR path. v0.99.1 does not change src/goal-extension.ts. The only v0.99.1 docs/air-extensions.md edit adds the 'Approved plan identity' section for AIR plan operations, which is separate from the sections the patch edits. The candidate replays it onto the exact v0.99.1 tag with an unchanged stable patch-id (650615ee), so its added, removed and context lines are identical to the ledger commit. The full suite passes on the integration.
tests: npm exec -- vitest run src/tests/acp-agent.test.ts -t goal
